name: How long does rot damage repair take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does rot damage repair take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of rot damage repair depends on the scope and severity of the issue. Small, non-structural repairs might be completed within a day or two. More extensive damage involving structural elements, multiple areas, or requiring significant moisture source remediation could take several days to over a week. Factors like drying times for sealants or paints, and permit requirements in areas like Pacifica or Daly City, can also influence the timeline. A detailed project schedule can be provided after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a day for minor rot to over a week for extensive, structural damage, depending on scope and drying times.
